supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: moderate horizontal extension beyond the outer corners of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: pronounced contrast between the high-intensity light-colored muzzle and the low-intensity dark periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate 2D vertical thickness with a visible structural droop of the lower lip

other_distinctive_markers: presence of a small, light-colored spherical object protruding from the left corner of the mouth
